page.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin are very small and partly illegible; the first reads approximately "partim ab Langobardis ... Principis" and the second "partim ab ... Græci Imperatoris nomine gubernata". Date and regnal numerals in the columns (MDLXIII, MDLXXI, MDLXXIII, MDXCIII, MDXCIV as printed in old form) are transcribed in the text where clear; the ones in the narrow side columns are not reproduced. Some words in the Latin body are uncertain due to scan quality, notably the lines beginning "Narses" and "Alboinus".
